command: base="reports/physical_bridge_2026_09_05/silver_fermion_action_2026_10_11/"; seal=JSON.parse(File.read(base+"PRESEAL_REFINEMENT.json")); inp=JSON.parse(File.read(base+"INPUTS.json")); (seal.fetch("science_files")+inp.fetch("local_inputs")).each{|r|p=r.fetch("path");raise p unless File.size(p)==r.fetch("bytes") && Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==r.fetch("sha256")}; rec=JSON.parse(File.read(base+"RECEIPTS.json")); names={"NATIVE_FIRST.log"=>"native_first","REFERENCE_FIRST.log"=>"reference_first","FOCUSED_FIRST.log"=>"focused","REGRESSION_FIRST.log"=>"regression","NATIVE_RUN.log"=>"native","REFERENCE_RUN.log"=>"reference","FOCUSED_RUN.log"=>"focused_final","REGRESSION_RUN.log"=>"regression_final","INTEGRITY_RUN.log"=>"integrity_final","IDENTIFICATION_RUN.log"=>"identification"};names.each{|name,stem|r=rec.fetch("all_runs").fetch(stem);raise name unless File.size(base+name)==r.fetch("log_bytes") && Digest::SHA256.file(base+name).hexdigest==r.fetch("log_sha256") && r.fetch("exit_code")==0}; native=JSON.parse(File.read(base+"NATIVE_RUN.log"));ref=JSON.parse(File.read(base+"REFERENCE_RUN.log"));raise "predicate coverage" unless native.fetch("facts").size==22 && native.fetch("facts").values.all? && ref.fetch("predicates").size==27 && ref.fetch("predicates").values.all?;puts JSON.generate({science_hashes:7,input_hashes:5,literal_stdout_hashes:10,native_predicates:22,reference_predicates:27,all_match:true})
